title: SubjectRegistryRow
description: One row in the Study Dashboard subject registry table. Represents a single enrolled subject. hermes_profile_id must be present; null triggers BLOCKED_MISSING_HERMES_PROFILE_ID.

subject_id.description: Stable opaque subject identifier. Must never contain PII.

gumi_instance_id.description: Identifier of the active Gumi instance bound to this subject.

hermes_profile_id.description: Identifier of the active Hermes profile. Null triggers BLOCKED_MISSING_HERMES_PROFILE_ID and the row must be visually flagged.

condition.description: Study condition label assigned to this subject (e.g. control, treatment_a).

last_user_interaction_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last interaction initiated by the user, or null if none recorded.

last_gumi_initiative_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last proactive initiative from the Gumi instance, or null if none recorded.

risk.description: Current risk level for this subject. Values other than none contribute to active_risk_alerts.

pending_review.description: True if this subject has at least one item awaiting researcher review.
